A.strongest_objection: A lawful earlier result can narrow the possible remote words. Testing a later offer on an unreachable word could manufacture an impossibility.
A.design_response: Test each reachable branch with its actual ancillary state and basis paths. Compare the weaker condition on a particular coherent preparation and the stronger condition on every lawful input. Require the original target state to survive and test either half of a synchronized offer on its own.

B.strongest_objection: At fixed H, not-all-equal keeper words 011 and 001 can share the same accessible bits. A readout could report a correct third sign even if no reader can attest or display it.
B.design_response: Require an explicit damage comparison within the admitted guard or a weaker physical receipt and separate external audit. Charge for the direct-third carrier bits and classical signals, specify a reusable blank register, sequential displays, contrary and missing reports, and include every shared label in the resource bound.

B.strongest_objection: A correct numerical third sign could lack a recoverable keeper record. The common holder cannot distinguish every possible corruption of its keeper.
B.design_response: The amended design enrolls the 011/001 counterexample, distinguishes history-certified validity from the weaker locally readable marks, keeps both direct meter bits and pays for value and presence in each direction. It requires sequential direct and agreement displays in the same two banks and includes hidden labels in the comparison.
